name: AJAY SRIVASTAVA
description: Mr.Ajay Srivastava is a former Indian Trade Service (ITS) officer with over three decades of invaluable experience shaping trade strategies, steering WTO regulations, and navigating complex Free Trade Agreement negotiations for the Government of India. An alumnus of the prestigious Indian School of Business (ISB), he currently bridges the gap between policy and industry as the Founder of the Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI), where he leads impactful research on international economics and trade policy

name: MINAL BUCH
description: Minal Buch is a Chartered Accountant and Co-Founder of BizBrains Advisors, specialising in customs, import-export strategy, and regulatory advisory for manufacturers and exporters.

name: SHALABH SINGHAL
description: Mr.Shalabh Singhal is the Founder and CEO of Trademo, an AI and data infrastructure platform that provides global trade intelligence and compliance solutions. An alumnus of IIT (BHU) Varanasi and a CFA charterholder, he brings deep expertise in technology and finance from previous ventures, including co-founding the fintech firm ZipLoan. Today, he leads Trademo’s mission to modernize international commerce by building transparent, data-driven, and resilient supply chain systems.

name: VIDYA BHUSHAN
role: Director - Trading, India Distribution & Bulk Business, Bunge
description: Mr.Vidya Bhushan is the Director of Trading (India Distribution & Bulk Business) at Bunge India, where he leads bulk-trading operations across the country’s edible oils and agri-commodities market. An alumnus of the Indian Institute of Finance, Delhi and a qualified GAFTA arbitrator, he brings over two decades of deep domain expertise in international supply chains, risk management, and port logistics. Beyond his corporate leadership at Bunge, he actively shapes regional agricultural policies and trade dynamics as the Vice President of the Solvent Extractors' Association of India (SEA).

name: MAMTA THANVI PUROHIT
description: Ms. Mamta Thanvi Purohit is the Pre-Sales Manager at Trezix, where she leads digital transformation strategies to automate and streamline the global trade ecosystem. An alumna of the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) and the University of Mumbai, she brings nearly two decades of deep domain expertise in international trade, EXIM compliance, customs, and indirect taxation. Beyond her corporate technology leadership at Trezix, she has successfully managed large-scale cross-border operations and regulatory frameworks for prominent Indian conglomerates, having previously served as the Manager of Customs and Foreign Trade at Tata International and Senior Manager of EXIM Compliances at Raymond Limited.

name: SHAVETA KAPOOR
role: Global Applied Data Science Head of Media Products, Dunnhumby
description: Shaveta Kapoor is Global ADS Head of Media Products at dunnhumby, leading a 100+ strong media analytics hub and the company's AI enablement agenda across Applied Data Science  embedding agentic AI, smart modules, and intelligent automation into everyday delivery. With 17+ years driving data science transformation at scale, she is a recognised AI leader (India's 100 Most Influential AI Leaders, 2024), an ISB Leadership-in-AI alumna, and a passionate champion of diversity and inclusion.

name: ARUN PANDIT
description: Mr. Arun Pandit is the Co-Founder of the national award-winning startup Hyphen SCS, India’s largest integrated warehousing and fulfilment platform. Hyphen SCS was the winner of the Wharton India Startup Challenge (2024) and the South Asia ICT Award (2024). An IIFT alumnus, he is the National Chairman of AIMA’s Young Leaders Council and a member of FICCI’s National Committee on Logistics.

name: MITESH LOHIYA
description: Mitesh Lohiya is the Director of Lohiya Group, representing next-generation leadership driving sales, marketing, and strategic growth. He is a chemical engineer from CBIT with a post-graduate qualification in management from NMIMS, Mumbai, alongside executive education from the Indian School of Business (ISB). He focuses heavily on sustainable manufacturing, innovation, and implementing new-age technologies to enhance production efficiency. Beyond his corporate leadership, he is also one of the founders of Street Cause, one of the largest youth-run NGOs.

name: SIDDHARTHA GHOSH
role: Ex- Chief Operating Officer, Ex- Yogabar, ITC
description: Siddhartha Ghosh is an experienced corporate leader and the former Chief Operating Officer of Yoga Bar (Sprout Life Foods), where he spearheaded operational execution and growth. Prior to his leadership role at Yoga Bar, he spent over a decade at ITC Limited holding diverse senior management positions spanning supply chain, manufacturing operations, category development, and process excellence. He is an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay (IIT Bombay).

name: PRANAV KUMAR
role: Vice President, International Trade Policy and Compliance, Reliance Industries Limited
description: Pranav Kumar is the Vice President of International Trade Policy and Compliance at Reliance Industries Limited, where he directs strategic trade initiatives, policy frameworks, and compliance mechanisms. Before joining Reliance, he held key leadership responsibilities heading the international trade policy division at the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), bringing extensive expertise in global trade dynamics and regulatory affairs.
